title: GEE (Google Earth Engine) Provider
description: Tiles from Google Earth Engine map IDs. Used for real-time satellite analysis products.

body.url: GEE tile URL with {z}/{x}/{y}, typically formatted as: https://earthengine.googleapis.com/v1alpha/projects/.../maps/{mapid}/tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}. Usually generated server-side and stored here.

layer_config_schema.decodeFunction: Internal — automatically set to the 'birds' decode function for canvas rendering.
layer_config_schema.canvas: Always true for GEE layers (uses canvas rendering).

examples.description: GEE tile layer with pre-computed map ID URL

notes: GEE tile URLs are typically generated by a separate GEE Lambda function and stored in layer_config.
The GEE Lambda signs requests and returns a time-limited tile URL.
For new GEE layers, the url in body is required — it must be a valid GEE map tile URL.
